purpose: Finds rows whose measure sits outside Tukey's fences: an order worth far more than the store's usual order, or a group far above the rest.
data: One candidate per side that has rows beyond its fence. The fences are Q1 - k x IQR and Q3 + k x IQR over the subject's rows, with quantiles interpolated linearly (type 7). k is 3 by default, Tukey's far-out fence. Skipped under minRows rows, and when Q1 equals Q3, since the fence would then flag every value off the median.
